title: A Theory of Non-Acyclic Generative Flow Networks
venue: AAAI 2024 (Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence 38(10): 11124-11131)
one_line_en: Extends GFlowNet flow theory to measurable spaces with cycles via 0-flows, proves ratio-type FM/DB/TB losses are unstable (flows pile into cycles) and gives a family of difference-type stable losses; the appendix characterizes R-flows as one acyclic flow plus the cycle space and bounds expected trajectory length by total flow.
one_line_zh: 用 0-flow 把 GFlowNet 流理论推广到含环的可测空间，证明比值型 FM/DB/TB 损失不稳定（流堆进环里）并给出差值型稳定损失族；附录把 R-流集合刻画为「一个无环流 + 环空间」，并以总流上界期望轨迹长度。
